en.headline: Hong Kong to name Green Energy Corridor mainland partner city in November
en.dek: Transport Secretary Mable Chan said the government will announce the partner city at a maritime conference and aims to sign a cooperation agreement for stable green bunkering supply.
body: Hong Kong plans to unveil the mainland city it will partner with for its first Green Energy Corridor during a maritime conference in November, Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said on Monday.

Under the city's first five-year plan and the Policy Address, the government aims to establish five green shipping and energy corridors by 2030. Chan said the SAR expects to sign a cooperation agreement with the chosen city to secure a stable supply of green energy for bunkering.

She noted Hong Kong's advantages in building a bunkering supply chain and a trading platform for green energy. The second list of partner ports will focus on attracting more routes from Southeast Asia, South America and Europe.

Chan also said the government is pushing to forge a "brother port" relationship with Shanghai in 2026. Both cities are international shipping hubs often affected by extreme weather, and the two sides are exploring complementary measures such as regular barge services and smart weather monitoring systems.

zh.headline: 陳美寶：11月公布綠色能源走廊內地合作城市
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長表示，政府將於11月海運會議公布首個綠色能源走廊的內地合作城市，並期望簽署合作協議以確保綠色船燃穩定供應。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶星期一表示，政府計劃於11月的一個海運會議上，公布香港首個「綠色能源走廊」將與哪一個內地城市合作。
根據香港首份五年規劃及施政報告，當局目標在2030年前建立五條綠色航運及能源走廊。陳美寶指，預期會與選定城市簽署合作協議，以確保綠色能源加注的穩定供應。
她指出，香港在建立綠色船燃供應鏈及交易平台方面具有優勢。第二批合作港口名單將聚焦吸引更多來自東南亞、南美及歐洲的航線。
陳美寶亦表示，政府正推動於2026年與上海建立「兄弟港」關係。兩地同為國際航運樞紐，常受極端天氣影響，雙方正探討互補措施，例如開設定期駁船服務及使用智能系統監察天氣。
